preview.what: Idempotency: making retries safe so a repeated request doesn't double-charge.
preview.picture: Pressing the lift button twice doesn't call two lifts. The idempotency key is the button remembering it was already pressed.
preview.why: Payments and webhooks questions always land here.
preview.bn: Lift-এর বোতাম দুবার চাপলে দুটো lift আসে না — idempotency key = বোতামের মনে থাকা যে চাপা হয়েছে।
